description.text: The second enhanced expansion pack of the Sun & Moon series, released on 21 April 2017 to strengthen decks built from Islands Await You, Alolan Moonlight and the Tapu Bulu-GX starter set. Tapu Fini, guardian deity of Poni Island, arrived as a Pokémon-GX, joined by Darkrai-GX, Machamp-GX, Salazzle-GX, Tapu Bulu-GX and Lycanroc-GX. Every card is holo, and each pack held five, one of them a basic Energy, adding the types the first enhanced pack lacked. The cards are numbered to 49, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Acerola and Sophocles, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, gold Ultra Rare Choice Band, Multi Switch and Darkness Energy, and the holo basic Energy.
